title: AI能否评估AI科学家？基于自动多模型评审的自主研究生成系统基准测试研究
summary: 提出用前沿LLM作为自动同行评审，从原创性、严谨性、清晰度、重要性四维度评估AI科学家系统。对Sakana AI、CycleResearcher、Data-to-Paper及FARS生成的75篇论文进行评测，发现FARS显著领先，且Gemini与Claude评审高度一致，验证了多模型评估的可靠性。
summary_en: Proposes an automated peer-review protocol using frontier LLMs to evaluate AI Scientist systems across four dimensions. Testing on 75 papers from four frameworks, FARS outperforms others, and Gemini/Claude show high agreement, validating multi-model evaluation reliability.
